speaker: Damián
en: (Sets down the hammer, with a satisfied expression) That's what I'm talking about!

speaker: Damián
cn: 拆家费我就不跟你们要了，以后少来我面前晃！
en: Consider the demolition free of charge. Now stay the hell out of my face!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （愤怒）Damián，你不就是想逼着我嫁给你吗？你做梦！
en: (Angry) Damián, you’re doing all this just to force me to marry you, aren’t you? In your dreams!

speaker: Margarita
cn: （不可置信）这发生了什么？我家怎么变成这样了！
en: (In disbelief) What happened? My house is ruined!

speaker: Damián
cn: （不好意思）抱歉，Yolanda女士，我迟到了。

speaker: Damián
cn: 自我介绍一下，我叫Damián。是这个项目的对接员。
en: Let me introduce myself. I’m Damián, your point of contact for this project.

speaker: Yolanda
cn: （诱惑）Damián？真是个好名字。这样吧，你跟我去一趟酒店，这个项目我就跟你们公司签，怎么样？
en: Damián? What a lovely name. How about this—you come to a hotel with me, and I’ll sign the deal with your company. What do you say?

speaker: Damián(VO)
cn: （倒吸一口凉气）Samanta，你怎么跟这样的人合作啊！怪不得Luis让我来！
en: Samanta, how do you even work with someone like this? No wonder Luis dumped this project on me!

speaker: Damián
cn: 那个，我们还是坐下说吧。

speaker: Damián
cn: 哎呀！合同我落在车上了！我这就去拿。
en: Oh no! I left the contract in the car! I'll go get it right away!

speaker: Yolanda
cn: （志在必得）小东西，你逃不掉的。
en: Pretty boy, you’re not getting away that easily.
